issue.title: [ci, perf] feat: add case-level parallel scheduling for accelerator CI

repository.name: VeOmni
repository.description: VeOmni: Scaling Any Modality Model Training with Model-Centric Distributed Recipe Zoo

issue.body:
### Why

Serial test-file execution leaves accelerator capacity idle, while duplicate training and large synthetic models add runtime. This PR reduces CI time while retaining backend and parallel-topology coverage.

### What does this PR do?

- Add a shared GPU/NPU case scheduler using existing `nproc`/`world_size` launch plans. Schedule larger reservations first and greedily fill available devices, without historical timing inputs.
- Isolate workers, caches and ports; cancel peers on the first failure and show case progress, heartbeats and complete failed-worker output, including child tracebacks. `--keep-going` continues ordinary failures; process-cleanup failures always abort.
- Remove one redundant Wan e2e invocation and fold Qwen3-MoE EP1/4/8 HF-save checks into existing saveload tests, retaining their assertions.
- Reduce eleven shared toy configs while preserving required layer/expert structure, backends, parallel sizes and numerical tolerances.
- Move test selection into GPU/NPU JSON manifests under `scripts/ci/accelerator/suites/`; workflows retain machine/dependency setup. GPU/NPU unit and e2e all use parallel dispatch.

### Test

Actual CI comparison against [PR #1328](https://github.com/ByteDance-Seed/VeOmni/pull/1328) (`c84d10db6`, attempt 2), using this PR's successful runs at `1a6428827` (attempt 2). GPU jobs use eight L20 GPUs; NPU jobs use eight Ascend 910B devices.

Times cover each suite's first test-step start through its final test-step completion, excluding queueing, initial setup and final job cleanup. These are individual CI runs across revisions and hosts in the same runner fleets.

| Suite | #1328 baseline | This PR | Time saved | Reduction |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| GPU unit | [94m 39s](https://github.com/ByteDance-Seed/VeOmni/actions/runs/39544886679/job/119073075300) | [38m 32s](https://github.com/ByteDance-Seed/VeOmni/actions/runs/39619014737/job/119294714288) | 56m 07s | 59.3% |
| GPU e2e | [45m 00s](https://github.com/ByteDance-Seed/VeOmni/actions/runs/39544886709/job/119073063877) | [25m 07s](https://github.com/ByteDance-Seed/VeOmni/actions/runs/39619014892/job/119294691625) | 19m 53s | 44.2% |
| NPU unit | [78m 16s](https://github.com/ByteDance-Seed/VeOmni/actions/runs/39544886747/job/119073077371) | [41m 03s](https://github.com/ByteDance-Seed/VeOmni/actions/runs/39619014804/job/119294686453) | 37m 13s | 47.6% |
| NPU e2e | [46m 07s](https://github.com/ByteDance-Seed/VeOmni/actions/runs/39544886690/job/119073077242) | [31m 06s](https://github.com/ByteDance-Seed/VeOmni/actions/runs/39619014539/job/119294673569) | 15m 01s | 32.6% |

### Usage

```sh
uv run --frozen python -m scripts.ci.accelerator --backend cuda --suite unit --include-conditional
uv run --frozen python -m scripts.ci.accelerator --backend npu --suite unit
```

Use `--suite e2e` for e2e tests; `--serial` is available for manual diagnosis.

When adding tests:

- Existing collection scopes automatically pick up new cases/files. Register files outside those scopes in `suites/gpu.json` and/or `suites/npu.json`, instead of adding pytest workflow steps.
- Declare multi-card or CPU cases with `pytest.mark.launch_plan(provider=...)`, reusing actual launch parameters. Unmarked cases default to one accelerator, or CPU on a CPU runner.

See the [accelerator README](https://github.com/Zx55/VeOmni/blob/6969bf44b558e8921b50b71fbf718cdf1012ab0a/scripts/ci/accelerator/README.md) for commands and the [test-author guide](https://github.com/Zx55/VeOmni/blob/6969bf44b558e8921b50b71fbf718cdf1012ab0a/docs/testing.md#registering-tests-in-ci) for manifest registration and launch plans.
